text: The scaffolding template does not re-seed the defect: a utility freshly generated by 'utilz generate' answers the pair form on BOTH invocation paths while carrying no --version arm of its own. Pinned by GENERATING one and running it, not by inspecting the template's text -- a template can be correct today and a later edit re-adds the arm, whereas a regeneration test fails the moment the mint does. This row exists because opt/utilz/tmpl/script.tmpl carried the arm: without it the thirteen deletions would have been undone one new utility at a time, silently, starting from the next 'utilz generate'.
